annotations.title: Check a pay offer or range

description: Where a job offer's pay, or a posted pay range, sits on the official pay distribution for the same job and place: the percentile span, the median, US take-home pay at the midpoint after federal and state tax, and for US metro areas which Department of Labor wage level (entry to fully competent) the pay meets. Same places as get_pay.

job.description: Job title, FedSalary slug or occupation code.

min.description: Low end of the range, or the only figure.

place.description: us, ca, uk, a US state or large metro area, a Canadian province or a UK region.

unit.description: year or hour. UK places take year only.
